name: postgres-ts-sql
description: Syntax highlighting and inferred result types for sql`...` template literals, using your migrations folder as the schema.

commands.title: Postgres TS: Update SQL result types in this file
Postgres TS: Reload schema from migrations

postgresTs.migrationsDir.description: Folder containing .sql migrations. Relative paths are looked up from each file's directory upwards to the workspace root, so every package of a pnpm/yarn/npm workspace can have its own.

postgresTs.migrationsExclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to the migrations folder) of files that are not applied.

postgresTs.tags.description: Template tag names whose queries get typed (`sql` matches `sql`...`` and `db.sql`...``). Highlighting always covers `sql` and `SQL`.

postgresTs.typeTemplate.markdownDescription: Shape of the generated type argument. `{{row}}` is replaced with the row object type. Use `{{row}}[]` for libraries whose generic is the result array (e.g. postgres.js).

postgresTs.updateOnSave.description: Insert/refresh inferred type arguments when a file is saved.

postgresTs.typeOverrides.markdownDescription: Map Postgres type names to TypeScript types, e.g. `{ "int8": "bigint", "jsonb": "Record<string, unknown>" }`.

postgresTs.diagnostics.description: Severity for unknown tables/columns in queries.

postgresTs.reportParseErrors.description: Report queries the SQL parser cannot parse (off by default because SQL fragments are often interpolated into larger queries).
